sentences.text: Andre Romelle Young -LRB- born February 18 , 1965 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Dr. Dre , is an American rapper , record producer , and entrepreneur .	stage name	stage name
He is the founder and current CEO of Aftermath Entertainment and Beats Electronics .	Aftermath Entertainment	Aftermath Entertainment	Beats Electronics	Beats Electronics
Dre was previously the co-owner of , and an artist on , Death Row Records .	Death Row	Death Row Records	Death Row Records	Death Row Records

He has produced albums for and overseen the careers of many rappers , including 2Pac , The D.O.C. , Snoop Dogg , Eminem , Xzibit , Knoc-turn ` al , 50 Cent , The Game and Kendrick Lamar .	Snoop Dogg	Snoop Dogg	2Pac	Tupac Shakur	Xzibit	Xzibit	Eminem	Eminem	50 Cent	50 Cent	The Game	Game (rapper)	Kendrick Lamar	Kendrick Lamar

He is credited as a key figure in the popularization of West Coast G-funk , a style of rap music characterized as synthesizer-based with slow , heavy beats .	G-funk	G-funk	West Coast	West Coast hip hop	rap	rap	music	music

In 2014 , Dr. Dre was ranked as the second richest figure in the American hip hop scene by Forbes with a net worth of $ 550 million ; he is at the top of the 2015 Forbes list , with an estimated pre-tax take of $ 620 million in 2014 .	Forbes	Forbes magazine

Dre began his career as a member of the World Class Wreckin ' Cru and later found fame with the influential gangsta rap group N.W.A with Eazy-E , Ice Cube , MC Ren , and DJ Yella , which popularized the use of explicit lyrics in rap to detail the violence of street life .	gangsta rap	gangsta rap	N.W.A	N.W.A	Eazy-E	Eazy-E	Ice Cube	Ice Cube	rap	rap	MC Ren	MC Ren	DJ Yella	DJ Yella

His 1992 solo debut The Chronic , released under Death Row Records , led him to become one of the best-selling American performing artists of 1993 and to win a Grammy Award for the single `` Let Me Ride '' .	Death Row	Death Row Records	Death Row Records	Death Row Records	The Chronic	The Chronic	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Let Me Ride	Let Me Ride

That same year he produced Death Row labelmate Snoop Dogg 's quadruple platinum debut Doggystyle , and even molded artists into top-notch producers such as his step-brother Warren G , which led to his Multi-Platinum debut Regulate ... G Funk Era in 1994 , and Snoop Dogg 's cousin Daz Dillinger which led to the double platinum debut album Dogg Food by Tha Dogg Pound in 1995 . He produced a compilation album titled Dr. Dre Presents the Aftermath in 1996 , and released a solo album titled 2001 in 1999 .	Dr. Dre Presents the Aftermath	Dr. Dre Presents the Aftermath	2001	2001 (Dr. Dre album)
During the 2000s , he focused on production for other artists , while occasionally contributing vocals to songs .
Dr. Dre signed Eminem in 1998 and 50 Cent in 2002 to his record label respectively , while contributing production on their albums .	Eminem	Eminem	50 Cent	50 Cent
